_about: Stage 3 pipe layers (2026-09-08). Four GLBs in exports/, one per layer, built by scripts/build_pipes.py to ROUTING_PLAN.html and tied to the placed models. Every node carries extras.layer; a node with extras.config (sewer=city, hvac=gas_pack) is an alternate and stays hidden unless the house config matches. The era switch swaps materials only: replace the material named in 'swap' with the era's colour set. Geometry never changes with era.

default.label: 1990 to 2010, CPVC trunk and branch, PVC DWV

pre1950.label: Before 1950, galvanized supply, cast iron DWV
pre1950.joints: threaded, hub and spigot with lead

1950_1970.label: 1950 to 1970, copper supply, cast iron stacks with PVC coming in

1970_1990.label: 1970 to 1990, copper or grey polybutylene, ABS or PVC

2010_now.label: 2010 to now, PEX on a manifold or trunk and branch, PVC, CSST
2010_now.joints: crimp or expansion rings, solvent, CSST bonded
